title: Senior Business Analyst (Strategy & Operations)
description: We are seeking a Business Analyst to bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technical development teams. You will gather requirements, map business processes, and translate strategic goals into actionable technical specifications.
responsibilities: Lead requirements gathering sessions with business leaders, product teams, and engineering.
Author detailed functional requirement specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria in JIRA.
Conduct current-state vs future-state business process mapping (BPMN / Visio).
Analyze operational workflows and build executive KPI dashboards in Power BI or Tableau.
requirements: 3+ years experience as a Business Analyst or Business Systems Analyst.
Proficiency in Agile/Scrum methodologies, JIRA, and Confluence.
Strong skills in advanced Excel (vlookup, pivot tables, data modeling) and SQL.
Exceptional verbal and written communication and stakeholder management.
